name: Sárok (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, red, white and green, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Sárok (a quartered shield with the dates 1290, 1526, 1699 and 1996) below the name SÁROK in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
